Learned counsel for the parties have tendered Minutes of Order dated 8 August, 2024 submitting that this petition be disposed of in terms of the Minutes of Order, which records the consensus as arrived between the parties including in regard to the pending Civil Appeals referred to in paragraphs 5, 7 and 8 of the Minutes of Order.

sentences.text: They are accordingly taken on record and marked 'X' for identification.

Insofar as paragraph 5 of the Minutes of Order are concerned, the parties agree that respondent no. 3, namely, Competent Authority/Sub- Divisional Officer be directed to transfer the amount of compensation "along with interest" thereupon towards the acquisition within four weeks from today to the credit of the pending Civil Appeals.
Mr. Patel, learned AGP, however, objects that the principal amount of compensation would be required to be deposited and not the interest.

4. We are not inclined to accept such contention as urged by Mr. Patel considering the provisions of Section 80 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short "the Act") which, in our opinion, would become applicable in the facts and circumstances in hand inasmuch neither the compensation has been paid to the persons to whom it is required to be paid nor it is deposited in the appropriate Court.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
We note the provisions of Section 80, which reads thus:
"Section 80 - Payment of interest.
When the amount of such compensation is not paid or deposited on or before taking possession of the land, the Collector shall pay the amount awarded with interest thereon at the rate of nine per cent.
per annum from the time of so taking possession until it shall have been so paid or deposited:
Provided that if such compensation or any part thereof is not paid or deposited within a period of one year from the date on which possession is taken, interest at the rate of fifteen per cent.
per annum shall be payable from the date or expiry of 8 August, 2024 WP2902_2023.DOC
the said
period of one year
on the amount of compensation or part thereof which has not been paid or deposited before the date of such expiry."

5. In these circumstances, the fact situation would be covered by the first part of Section 80 and the compensation amount would be required to be deposited by respondent no. 3 along with 9% interest p.a.
Let such amount be deposited within four weeks from today to the credit of the pending civil appeals.
An appropriate order in regard to the investment of amounts can be passed by the learned District Judge hearing the appeals.
6. In this view of the matter, we dispose of the matter in terms of Minutes of Order and our aforesaid observations and directions.
7. Disposed of.
No costs.
